name: Aconcagua: Laguna de Horcones and Confluencia
why: Walk into the Horcones valley under the highest mountain outside Asia, to the first base camp at 3,400 m.
book: A day trekking permit from the park (buy online before you go). The short loop to Laguna de Horcones needs only the entry ticket.
water: None on the trail before Confluencia: carry 2 litres.
dangers: Altitude: you start at 2,950 m. Don't do it the day you arrive from Mendoza at 750 m.
Strong sun and dry wind: sunburn in an hour.
turnaround: If you have a headache before Confluencia, go back: it is the altitude.
